scholarships.title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students

existing.description: Dublin City University offers partial merit-based international scholarships to non-EU students across its four faculties and the DCU Business School. Applicants are automatically considered when they apply as a non-EU student, and only successful recipients are notified by email, with the reduction applied directly to their student account. The value varies by faculty and programme, ranging from €1,850 to €6,100 off the full-time 2027-28 Non-EU tuition fee. Recipients cannot also be considered for another DCU scholarship.
eligibility: Application to a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate programme listed as eligible for 2027-28
High-achieving merit-based requirement for the Humanities and Social Sciences postgraduate award
Must not already hold another DCU scholarship, as recipients cannot be considered for an additional DCU award
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to non-EU nationals applying to a listed undergraduate or postgraduate programme at Dublin City University. Consideration for the scholarship is automatic on application; no separate scholarship application exists.
benefits: Humanities and Social Sciences postgraduate: €2,000 fee reduction
Humanities and Social Sciences undergraduate: €1,850 fee reduction
Engineering and Computing postgraduate: €4,400 fee reduction
Engineering and Computing undergraduate: €5,000 fee reduction
Science and Health postgraduate: €5,000 or €4,500 fee reduction depending on programme
Science and Health undergraduate: €6,100 fee reduction, or €3,100 for DC204 BSc in Athletic Therapy and Training
coverage: Partial reduction of the full-time 2027-28 Non-EU tuition fee, applied directly to the student account
requirements: Apply as a non-EU student to DCU on a listed eligible programme
Meet the academic entry requirements of the chosen programme
Note that a DCU International Scholarship cannot be combined with another DCU scholarship
documents: DCU course application for an eligible 2027-28 programme
application_method: No separate application: apply to DCU and the applicant is automatically considered
existing.selection_notes: Successful recipients are notified by email only; the fee reduction is applied directly to the student account. Awards are merit-based.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving non-EU applicants with an application to DCU on one of the listed 2027-28 undergraduate or postgraduate programmes.
existing.notes: The DCU Merit Scholarship for Non-EU Students is also automatic on application. Eligibility lists specific programme codes for 2027-28 in each faculty, so the applicant must check that their chosen programme appears on the list.
existing.application_period: Awarded for the 2027-28 academic year, tied to the corresponding course application cycle.
existing.deadline_display: No separate scholarship deadline is published. Applicants are "automatically considered" for the scholarship when they apply as a non-EU student to DCU, so the relevant date is the course application deadline.
existing.program_type: This merit based scholarship is available for high achieving Non-EU applicants that have received an offer to study on a postgraduate programme in the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences.
